role: Encrypted model storage, versioning, conversion, and lifecycle management across 23+ formats.

capabilities.name: vault.list
capabilities.description: List all models in the vault. Metadata only; nothing is decrypted.

capabilities.name: vault.versions
capabilities.description: Show versions of a model.

capabilities.name: vault.lineage
capabilities.description: Show version ancestry tree.

capabilities.name: vault.stats
capabilities.description: Show vault storage statistics.

capabilities.name: utility.cache
capabilities.description: Show cache statistics.

capabilities.name: conversion.list-conversions
capabilities.description: List supported format conversion paths.

capabilities.name: agent.introspect
capabilities.description: Output the CLI schema for agent discovery.

capabilities.name: security.compliance
capabilities.description: Run FIPS/CMMC/MITRE compliance checks. Reports; does not change the vault.

capabilities.name: utility.analyze
capabilities.description: Analyze model compression efficiency. Reads model content to measure it.

capabilities.name: utility.deduplicate
capabilities.description: Find duplicate models in the vault. Scans the whole vault.

capabilities.name: vault.init
capabilities.description: Initialize a new encrypted vault.

capabilities.name: vault.store
capabilities.description: Store a model in the vault with encryption.

capabilities.name: vault.get
capabilities.description: Retrieve and DECRYPT a model out of the vault to a path the caller names.

capabilities.name: utility.export
capabilities.description: Export a model with its metadata.

capabilities.name: utility.archive
capabilities.description: Archive models to TAR or ZIP.

capabilities.name: utility.extract
capabilities.description: Extract models from an archive.

capabilities.name: conversion.convert
capabilities.description: Convert a model between formats.

capabilities.name: vault.delete
capabilities.description: Delete a model version.

capabilities.name: security.change-passphrase
capabilities.description: Change the vault encryption passphrase.

capabilities.name: api.serve
capabilities.description: Start the REST/GraphQL API server, exposing the vault over the network.

note: UNLIKE the other manifests in this stack, neither field here is derived: IronVault's CLI schema enumerates its commands but declares no effect, safety or authority data, so both requires_grant and budgeted are judgements made from the command semantics and are stated as such rather than presented as the tool's own position. The commands and their descriptions are IronVault's; the classification is not. The rule applied: a grant is required to decrypt, write, delete, change credentials, or expose the vault over the network. That makes `get` and `export` granted alongside the obvious mutators, because in an encrypted vault the operation that matters most is the one that takes plaintext out -- a manifest that granted `delete` but not `get` would guard the wrong door. `list`, `versions`, `lineage` and `stats` read metadata without decrypting anything and need no grant. Budgets follow size and duration: store, get, export, archive, extract and convert all move or transform whole models; analyze, deduplicate and compliance read across the vault to produce a report; serve runs until stopped. delete and change-passphrase are granted but unbudgeted -- single decisions, where the danger is that one was unauthorised rather than that many were made. This file should be replaced by a derived one if IronVault ever declares effects in its own schema, the way abt, Rodeo, Botnet, MAGE and HyperMachine do. Until then it is the weakest-grounded manifest in the stack and should be read that way.
